name: apnileap-monorepo
description: ApniLeap — Rule-Driven Campus Placement Eligibility and Analytics Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:a" "npm run dev:b" "npm run dev:c" "npm run dev:bff" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --workspace=@apnileap/eligibility" "npm run start --workspace=@apnileap/ranking" "npm run start --workspace=@apnileap/data-engine" "npm run start --workspace=@apnileap/bff"
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:a && npm run test:b && npm run test:c && npm run test:d
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:playwright && npm run test:kpi
